propositions: Plan-review attestations must remain valid only when pinned direct-child and prerequisite material matches their current fingerprints; drift in a pinned prerequisite or child invalidates the downstream review when enforcement is enabled

New passing reviews must sign cryptographic pins recording each direct child and direct prerequisite's canonical ID, role, and current narrow material fingerprint; legacy unpinned attestations remain valid and unmodified

Ticket review phase (planning or execution) must be maintained as a reducer projection surviving compaction; entry to in_progress establishes execution phase, entry to open resets planning phase, and losing fork events never alter phase
Execution-phase reviews must apply a fixed 0.80 priority floor in normal Pass 3 blocking-threshold resolution, while planning-phase reviews use the full stricter review without floor elevation

Close operations must require a current certified plan review when both require_plan_review_for_close and enforce_plan_material_pins are enabled, but code freshness alone must not invalidate the attestation

Prerequisite consistency evaluation must deterministically assess each direct prerequisite using current narrow material in isolated calls, recording one disposition per prerequisite (consistent, finding, or indeterminate) with indeterminate results yielding unsigned reviews
